audience.description: Adults who treat their sneakers like a collection: they rotate pairs, notice every scuff and crease, and want a clean pair before they step out. They follow sneaker culture, value a tidy shelf, and like simple tools that do one job well without risking the colors or materials of a pair they paid good money for.

brief.productRole: The kit is the star of a satisfying clean-up sequence. The pouch is unzipped, the stiff brush scrubs a scuffed white midsole, the foaming cleaner pumps into a thick lather on a knit upper worked with the soft brush, and the gray microfiber towel wipes the foam away to reveal a clean surface. The last shot packs everything back into the zip pouch.
brief.mood: Satisfying, confident, crisp, a little obsessive

music.style: Modern lo-fi hip-hop beat with a punchy kick, dry snare snaps, a warm muted bass and a simple electric piano loop, with a small percussive click on each reveal

visual.look: Tight macro and mid shots with a clean, slightly warm grade and strong contrast. Shallow depth of field on the bristles and foam, a soft key light from the side to show texture, fine grain. Fast cuts of about 1 second timed to the beat, with one split-screen before and after at the 10 second mark and a slow push-in on the finished pair at the end. Text overlays are minimal and large, all in the lower third.

wardrobe.styling: Plain heather gray hoodie or a solid black tee, relaxed dark trousers, no logos or visible text on any clothing. Sneakers on screen are unbranded in look: a white leather low-top with a scuffed midsole, a cream canvas pair, and a gray knit runner with mud splatter.

types: bright home sneaker shelf corner with a wooden floor
small apartment entryway with a mat and a bench
clean concrete-top workbench by a window

voice.tone: Dry, assured and a little playful, like a friend who is quietly particular about shoes
use: Names the exact problem, like creased toe boxes, scuffed soles and muddy knit
Describes the result in visible terms: bright midsole, clean mesh, colors intact
Mentions what comes in the pouch: cleaner, two brushes, one towel
Ends with a short, calm invitation to get the kit
avoid: Invented ratings, review counts or sales numbers
Speaking as a customer who tried it

hooks: That pair deserves better than a wet paper towel.
Scuffed midsoles end here. Watch this.
Your shelf is clean. Your sneakers should be too.

talent.description: One adult in their mid twenties with a calm, focused attitude and a short fade haircut, shown mostly from the hands and torso up with a few face glimpses at the end. A second adult friend in their late twenties appears briefly at the end admiring the finished pair. Both are fictional.
